title: DualHeads: Reward-tilted few-step diffusion made simple
title_zh: DualHeads：简洁的奖励倾斜少步扩散

paragraphs.en: DualHeads用奖励头和参考头两个轻量分类头对齐少步扩散生成器，无需可微奖励即达接近40步RL的性能。 Distilled diffusion models generate high-quality images in a few sampling steps, but aligning them with task requirements and human preferences is difficult. Methods developed for multi-step diffusion models rely on differentiable rewards, or on score fields and stochastic trajectories that distilled generators may lack. We ask whether a few-step generator can be adapted using only external reward evaluations and reference samples, and show that two binary classifiers suffice. Our method, DualHeads, implements them as lightweight heads on a frozen diffusion backbone. The reward head learns which samples of the same prompt score higher, the reference head separates reference images from generated ones, and the generator maximizes a weighted sum of their logits. When the heads are optimal, this objective is KL-regularized maximization of the learned reward, and the ratio of head weights sets the regularization strength. Empirically, with both rule-based and model-based rewards, a few-step DualHeads generator reaches task rewards close to those of 40-step reinforcement learning methods while preserving image quality, at no extra inference cost. We hope that this simple and elegant dual-head formulation will help advance few-step reward-tilted generation.
paragraphs.zh: DualHeads用奖励头和参考头两个轻量分类头对齐少步扩散生成器，无需可微奖励即达接近40步RL的性能。蒸馏后的扩散模型只需几个采样步骤即可生成高质量图像，但使其与任务需求和人类偏好对齐却很困难。 为多步扩散模型开发的方法依赖于可微奖励，或依赖于蒸馏生成器可能缺乏的分数场和随机轨迹。 我们探究是否可以仅使用外部奖励评估和参考样本来适配少步生成器，并证明两个二分类器即可奏效。 我们的方法DualHeads将它们实现为冻结扩散主干上的轻量头。 奖励头学习同一提示下哪些样本得分更高，参考头将参考图像与生成图像区分开，生成器则最大化两者logits的加权和。 当两个头达到最优时，该目标即为学习到的奖励的KL正则化最大化，且两个头权重的比值决定了正则化强度。 实验表明，无论使用基于规则还是基于模型的奖励，少步DualHeads生成器都能达到接近40步强化学习方法的任务奖励，同时保持图像质量，且不增加额外推理成本。 我们希望这一简洁优雅的双头公式有助于推进少步奖励倾斜生成的发展。
